scripts.ios:build: bun --cwd ../app build && rm -rf gen/apple/assets/* && cp -R ../app/build/* gen/apple/assets/
scripts.ios:rust: cargo build --target aarch64-apple-ios --release && mkdir -p gen/apple/Externals/arm64/release gen/apple/Externals/arm64/debug && cp target/aarch64-apple-ios/release/libilc_study_tool_lib.a gen/apple/Externals/arm64/release/libapp.a && cp target/aarch64-apple-ios/release/libilc_study_tool_lib.a gen/apple/Externals/arm64/debug/libapp.a
scripts.ios:open: bun run ios:build && bun run ios:xcode
scripts.ios:install:xspot: bun run ios:build && xcodebuild -project gen/apple/coursedeck-ipad.xcodeproj -scheme coursedeck-ipad_iOS -configuration release -destination 'id=a0db1cb93df7b788df78d121301d97c4ba6c2888' -allowProvisioningUpdates build && ios-deploy -i a0db1cb93df7b788df78d121301d97c4ba6c2888 -b $(xcodebuild -project gen/apple/coursedeck-ipad.xcodeproj -scheme coursedeck-ipad_iOS -configuration release -showBuildSettings | grep -m 1 'TARGET_BUILD_DIR =' | awk '{print $3}')/CourseDeck.app
